results.final_sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT upper(trim(procedure_code)) AS cpt, line_paid_amount AS paid FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT sum(paid) FILTER (WHERE cpt = 'G0483') / nullif(sum(paid), 0) AS share FROM lines

WITH per_payer AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(payer_class) AS payer_class, min(submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY 1, 2 ), primary_one AS ( SELECT * FROM per_payer QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY first_sub, payer_key) = 1 ), paid AS ( SELECT p.payer_class, date_diff('day', p.first_sub, r.payment_date) AS days_to_pay FROM primary_one p JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount > 0 ) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS paid_claims, round(median(days_to_pay), 1) AS median_days, round(quantile_cont(days_to_pay, 0.9), 1) AS p90_days FROM paid GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH denied_current AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND is_denied ), codes AS ( SELECT a.carc_code, a.claim_key, a.payer_key FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN denied_current d ON d.claim_key = a.claim_key AND d.payer_key = a.payer_key WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc ) SELECT carc_code, count(DISTINCT claim_key || '|' || payer_key) AS denied_claims FROM codes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY denied_claims DESC, carc_code LIMIT 5

WITH pairs AS ( SELECT min(payer_class) AS payer_class, claim_key, payer_key, count(*) AS events, bool_or(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) AS single_ok FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS remitted_pairs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE events = 1 AND single_ok) AS first_pass, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE events = 1 AND single_ok) / count(*), 2) AS first_pass_rate_pct FROM pairs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH pairs AS ( SELECT min(payer_class) AS payer_class, claim_key, payer_key, count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) AS traces, bool_or(is_reversal) AS has_reversal, bool_or(is_current_adjudication) AS has_current, coalesce(sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication), 0) AS current_paid FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key HAVING count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) >= 2 ) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS pairs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_reversal) AS with_reversal, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_current) AS no_current, round(coalesce(sum(current_paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid FROM pairs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
WITH current_lines AS ( SELECT line_is_denied, claim_is_denied FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT count(*) FROM current_lines WHERE line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied

WITH primary_pairs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' ), ded AS ( SELECT a.adjustment_amount FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN primary_pairs p ON p.claim_key = a.claim_key AND p.payer_key = a.payer_key WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'PR' AND a.carc_code = '1' ) SELECT round(coalesce(sum(adjustment_amount), 0), 2) FROM ded

WITH base AS ( SELECT service_month, referring_npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_month >= DATE '2026-06-01' ), totals AS (SELECT service_month, count(*) AS total_claims FROM base GROUP BY 1), by_npi AS ( SELECT service_month, referring_npi, count(*) AS claims FROM base WHERE referring_npi IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ), ranked AS ( SELECT * FROM by_npi QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY claims DESC, referring_npi) <= 5 ), top5 AS (SELECT service_month, sum(claims) AS top5_claims FROM ranked GROUP BY 1) SELECT strftime(t.service_month, '%Y-%m') AS service_month, t.total_claims, coalesce(x.top5_claims, 0) AS top5_claims, round(100.0 * coalesce(x.top5_claims, 0) / t.total_claims, 1) AS top5_share_pct FROM totals t LEFT JOIN top5 x USING (service_month) ORDER BY t.service_month

WITH lines AS ( SELECT upper(trim(procedure_code)) AS cpt, line_paid_amount AS paid FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT sum(paid) FILTER (WHERE cpt = '87798') / nullif(sum(paid), 0) AS share FROM lines

WITH billed AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.claim_key, c.payer_key, upper(trim(cl.procedure_code)) AS cpt FROM sem.claims c JOIN sem.claim_lines cl ON cl.claim_id = c.claim_id WHERE cl.procedure_code IS NOT NULL ), cur AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT b.cpt, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cur.is_denied) * 1.0 / count(*) AS denial_rate FROM billed b JOIN cur ON cur.claim_key = b.claim_key AND cur.payer_key = b.payer_key GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 20 ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS ( SELECT claim_key, charge_amount, CASE WHEN line_count = 1 THEN '1' WHEN line_count = 2 THEN '2' WHEN line_count >= 3 THEN '3+' END AS bucket FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission ), per_payer AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) first_sub FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY 1, 2 ), one AS ( SELECT * FROM per_payer QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY first_sub, payer_key) = 1 ), cur AS ( SELECT o.claim_key, r.is_denied FROM one o JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = o.claim_key AND r.payer_key = o.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication ) SELECT l.bucket, count(*) AS claims, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.is_denied) AS denied_claims, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.is_denied) / count(*), 2) AS denial_rate_pct, round(coalesce(sum(l.charge_amount) FILTER (WHERE c.is_denied), 0), 2) AS denied_charge FROM latest l JOIN cur c USING (claim_key) WHERE l.bucket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH fb AS ( SELECT provider_adjustment_id, payer_key, reference_id, payment_date, provider_adjustment_amount AS amount FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code = 'FB' ), carry AS (SELECT * FROM fb WHERE amount < 0), matched AS ( SELECT c.reference_id, c.payment_date AS carry_date, round(-c.amount, 2) AS carried, o.payment_date AS offset_date, date_diff('day', c.payment_date, o.payment_date) AS days, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.provider_adjustment_id ORDER BY o.payment_date) AS rn FROM carry c LEFT JOIN fb o ON o.payer_key = c.payer_key AND o.reference_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.reference_id AND round(o.amount, 2) = round(-c.amount, 2) AND o.payment_date > c.payment_date AND o.provider_adjustment_id <> c.provider_adjustment_id ) SELECT reference_id, carry_date, carried, offset_date, days FROM matched WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY carry_date, reference_id

WITH paid AS ( SELECT payer_class, sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01') AS july_paid, sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01') AS aug_paid FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payment_month IN (DATE '2026-07-01', DATE '2026-08-01') GROUP BY 1 ), tot AS (SELECT sum(july_paid) AS jtot, sum(aug_paid) AS atot FROM paid) SELECT payer_class, round(100.0 * coalesce(july_paid, 0) / jtot, 1), round(100.0 * coalesce(aug_paid, 0) / nullif(atot, 0), 1), round(100.0 * (coalesce(aug_paid, 0) / nullif(atot, 0) - coalesce(july_paid, 0) / jtot), 1) FROM paid, tot ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, submission_date, cast(frequency_code AS VARCHAR) AS freq FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' ), orig AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS orig_date FROM p WHERE freq = '1' GROUP BY 1, 2 ), repl AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS repl_date FROM p WHERE freq = '7' GROUP BY 1, 2 ), cur AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payment_date, paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT count(*) AS corrected_claims, round(avg(date_diff('day', o.orig_date, r.repl_date)), 2) AS avg_days_to_repl, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= r.repl_date) AS paid_after, round(avg(date_diff('day', o.orig_date, c.payment_date)) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= r.repl_date), 2) AS avg_days_to_pay, round(coalesce(sum(c.paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= r.repl_date), 0), 2) AS paid FROM repl r JOIN orig o USING (claim_key, payer_key) LEFT JOIN cur c USING (claim_key, payer_key)

results.final_sql: WITH voids AS ( SELECT claim_key, min(submission_date) AS void_date FROM sem.claims WHERE cast(frequency_code AS VARCHAR) = '8' GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM voids), (SELECT count(*) FROM voids v WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=v.claim_key AND r.paid_amount > 0 AND r.payment_date < v.void_date)), (SELECT count(*) FROM voids v WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=v.claim_key AND r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date >= v.void_date)), (SELECT round(coalesce(sum(r.paid_amount),0), 2) FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN voids v ON v.claim_key=r.claim_key WHERE r.is_current_adjudication)

WITH current AS ( SELECT paid_amount, is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication ), zero_pay AS ( SELECT * FROM current WHERE coalesce(paid_amount, 0) = 0 ) SELECT count(*) FROM zero_pay WHERE NOT is_denied

WITH repl AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) repl_date FROM sem.claims WHERE cast(frequency_code AS VARCHAR) = '7' GROUP BY 1, 2 ), resp AS ( SELECT r.payer_class, r.claim_key, r.payer_key, date_diff('day', r.repl_date, min(m.payment_date)) AS days FROM repl r JOIN sem.remit_claims m ON m.claim_key = r.claim_key AND m.payer_key = r.payer_key AND m.payment_date >= r.repl_date GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, r.repl_date ) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS responses, round(avg(days), 1) AS avg_days, min(days) AS min_days, max(days) AS max_days FROM resp GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH pairs AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, bool_or(is_reversal) AS was_reversed, bool_or(is_current_adjudication) AS has_current FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT count(*) FROM pairs WHERE was_reversed AND NOT has_current

WITH lines AS ( SELECT upper(trim(procedure_code)) AS cpt, line_paid_amount AS paid FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT sum(paid) FILTER (WHERE cpt = '80307') / nullif(sum(paid), 0) AS share FROM lines

WITH per_payer AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) first_sub FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY 1, 2 ), one AS ( SELECT * FROM per_payer QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY first_sub, payer_key) = 1 ), cohort AS ( SELECT * FROM one WHERE first_sub BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31' ), first_remit AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(payment_date) first_pay FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT c.payer_class, count(*) AS cohort_claims, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_pay IS NOT NULL AND date_diff('day', c.first_sub, fr.first_pay) <= 14) AS within_14, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE fr.first_pay IS NOT NULL AND date_diff('day', c.first_sub, fr.first_pay) <= 14) / count(*), 1) AS pct FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN first_remit fr USING (claim_key, payer_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH lines AS ( SELECT upper(trim(procedure_code)) AS cpt, line_paid_amount AS paid FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT sum(paid) FILTER (WHERE cpt = 'G0482') / nullif(sum(paid), 0) AS share FROM lines

WITH repl AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS repl_date FROM sem.claims WHERE cast(frequency_code AS VARCHAR) = '7' GROUP BY 1, 2 ), pop AS ( SELECT r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.repl_date FROM repl r WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims d WHERE d.claim_key = r.claim_key AND d.payer_key = r.payer_key AND cast(d.claim_status_code AS VARCHAR) = '4' AND d.payment_date < r.repl_date ) ), flags AS ( SELECT p.claim_key, p.payer_key, p.repl_date, coalesce(bool_or(m.payment_date >= p.repl_date), false) AS remit_since FROM pop p LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims m ON m.claim_key = p.claim_key AND m.payer_key = p.payer_key GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), cur AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, is_denied, paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication ), classified AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN NOT f.remit_since THEN 'no remit since correction' WHEN c.claim_key IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.is_denied THEN 'overturned' ELSE 'denied again' END AS outcome, coalesce(c.paid_amount, 0) AS paid FROM flags f LEFT JOIN cur c USING (claim_key, payer_key) ) SELECT outcome, count(*) AS claims, round(coalesce(sum(paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid FROM classified GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH earlier_denied AS ( SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE NOT is_reversal AND NOT is_current_adjudication AND is_denied AND NOT coalesce(is_duplicate_claim_denial, false) ), current_ok AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied ) SELECT count(*) AS overturned_pairs, round(coalesce(sum(c.paid_amount), 0), 2) AS current_paid FROM current_ok c JOIN earlier_denied e USING (claim_key, payer_key)

WITH latest AS ( SELECT claim_key, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND cast(frequency_code AS VARCHAR) <> '8' ), one AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, first_sub FROM ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) first_sub, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY min(submission_date), payer_key) rn FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ) t WHERE rn = 1 ), open_ar AS ( SELECT l.charge_amount, date_diff('day', o.first_sub, DATE '2026-08-14') age_days FROM latest l JOIN one o USING (claim_key) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=o.claim_key AND r.payer_key=o.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication) ) SELECT bucket, count(*), round(coalesce(sum(charge_amount),0), 2) FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN age_days <= 14 THEN '0-14' WHEN age_days <= 29 THEN '15-29' ELSE '30+' END bucket, charge_amount FROM open_ar ) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN '0-14' THEN 1 WHEN '15-29' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

WITH firsts AS ( SELECT claim_key, min(submission_date) AS first_sub, bool_or(has_remit) AS has_remit FROM sem.claims GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT count(*) FROM firsts WHERE first_sub >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND first_sub < DATE '2026-08-01' AND NOT has_remit

results.final_sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT payer_key, payer_name, upper(trim(procedure_code)) AS cpt, line_allowed_amount AS allowed FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT coalesce(line_is_denied, false) AND units_paid = 1 AND line_allowed_amount > 0 ), freq AS ( SELECT payer_key, cpt, allowed, count(*) n FROM lines GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), typical AS ( SELECT payer_key, cpt, allowed AS typical_allowed FROM freq QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY payer_key, cpt ORDER BY n DESC, allowed DESC) = 1 ) SELECT min(l.payer_name) AS payer, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.allowed < t.typical_allowed) AS underpaid_lines, round(coalesce(sum(t.typical_allowed - l.allowed) FILTER (WHERE l.allowed < t.typical_allowed), 0), 2) AS shortfall FROM lines l JOIN typical t USING (payer_key, cpt) GROUP BY l.payer_key ORDER BY shortfall DESC, payer

WITH lines AS ( SELECT upper(trim(procedure_code)) AS cpt, line_paid_amount AS paid FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT sum(paid) FILTER (WHERE cpt = 'G0480') / nullif(sum(paid), 0) AS share FROM lines

WITH monthly AS ( SELECT payer_class, payment_month, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication GROUP BY 1, 2 ), rates AS ( SELECT *, denied * 1.0 / n AS rate FROM monthly ) SELECT payer_class, strftime(payment_month, '%Y-%m') AS month, n, denied, round(100 * rate, 2) AS denial_rate_pct, round(100 * (rate - lag(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY payer_class ORDER BY payment_month)), 2) AS mom_pp FROM rates ORDER BY payer_class, payment_month

WITH lines AS ( SELECT upper(trim(procedure_code)) AS cpt, line_paid_amount AS paid FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT sum(paid) FILTER (WHERE cpt = '81479') / nullif(sum(paid), 0) AS share FROM lines

WITH primary_sub AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, referring_npi FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date DESC, claim_id DESC) = 1 ), cur AS ( SELECT p.referring_npi, r.is_denied FROM primary_sub p JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND p.referring_npi IS NOT NULL ) SELECT referring_npi, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) * 1.0 / count(*) AS denial_rate FROM cur GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 15 ORDER BY denial_rate DESC, referring_npi LIMIT 5
